title: The Heart, Blood and Circulation
summary: The four-chambered heart, the double loop of circulation, arteries and veins, the pulse, and what blood is made of.

ib.note: Blood pressure and heart disease follow in MYP 5

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT Ch 11: Transportation in Animals and Plants
Curiosity Ch 9: Life Processes in Animals (check coverage)

objectives: I can describe the path of blood through the heart, lungs and body.
I can distinguish arteries, veins and capillaries.
I can name the components of blood and their functions.
misconceptions: The heart is on the left side of the chest (it is roughly central, tilted left).
